BC250 Control Center is a graphical interface for managing, preparing, and monitoring community tools for the AMD BC-250 board.

What the application does:
• Brings GPU, CPU, 40CU, processes, memory, sensors, and history into one window.
• Prepares dependencies on supported distributions so a fresh installation is ready without searching the internet for commands.
• Provides profiles and actions with warnings, validation, and visible limits.
• Shows paths, service state, and important output so the user understands what is happening.

What it uses internally:
• cyan-skillfish-governor-smu to control GPU ranges through the governor/D-Bus interface.
• bc250_smu_oc for temporary or persistent CPU OC when the user explicitly chooses it.
• bc250-cu-live-manager for the live dashboard and 40CU/24CU actions.
• nct6687d for experimental fan PWM control after that module is prepared.
• UMR, lm_sensors, systemd, Polkit, and system tools when required.

Project credit and scope:
• Our work is a graphical launcher/control center that integrates, organizes, and manages these repositories in a friendlier way.
• We do not claim authorship of external community tools; each retains its credits, license, and official repository.
• The nct6687d driver retains its upstream credits and license at Fred78290/nct6687d.
• The goal is to make the BC-250 comfortable to use without relying as much on the terminal or navigating between multiple repositories.

Important:
• Overclocking, 40CU, and frequency changes can cause freezes, shutdowns, data loss, or hardware damage.
• Every BC-250 is different; test gradually and at your own risk.
